ec0f5d7b-369d-55cc-a238-b776c6b0271f.content: Limit the proposal body to a maximum of two pages.

78acd8e3-6cc0-5fa0-a60d-d1f80e21e00a.content: References are not included in the two-page limit for the body text.

21dd4a7f-f397-5d2a-b675-a4800c262a27.content: Figures and tables placed within the body count toward the two-page limit for the body text.

bff84712-882c-5a0d-a3e4-0e77912d9d3b.content: Maintain a font size of 11 points or larger in the body text.

0dfe0e3c-999d-58da-93d3-796e3954ca2b.content: Format all pages to US Letter size.

f7e050f7-a5ed-5bea-b5b1-5decfc51edd7.content: Use Arial for the body typeface.

b641d18e-e6d4-5967-a01c-11182fafa8a8.content: Maintain margins of at least one inch on all four sides of every page.

801a95cb-fe6a-53f7-9e1a-e12ced336f34.content: Reviewers often scan figures and tables separately from the main text first.
